answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the echo proves it. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The price of trying is a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes, paid up front for every single name, while the echo stays small. One name, one proof, one entry: Cellarbound champagne bottler press charter enforces it, and a charter champagne bottlers hold after wine cellar inspections is how the check runs. The clerk notes nectar. One spiral, one entry.
